De Blob 2.name: De Blob 2
De Blob 2.summary: In de Blob 2 Comrade Black and the Inkies are back with a whole new plot to rid the world of color. Set off on an action-packed color adventure where custom paints, patterns and music bring the world to life. De Blob 2 is a creative evolution driven by your imagination.

International Cricket 2010.name: International Cricket 2010
International Cricket 2010.summary: International Cricket 2010 is a console cricket simulation with official England and Australia teams, expanded international rosters, and a bigger set of tournament formats. It features Action Cam, giving on-field perspectives from multiple angles for both batting and bowling, alongside new gameplay tools like improved control and the Power Stick. Multiplayer includes online match play and a sportsmanship rating system, while the AI aims to make batting and on-field reactions feel more realistic.

Red Dead Redemption - Game of the Year E.name: Red Dead Redemption: Game of the Year Edition
Red Dead Redemption - Game of the Year E.summary: Red Dead Redemption: Game of the Year Edition will include the full, original Red Dead Redemption game plus all free and paid downloadable content packs released to date, including the wildly popular Undead Nightmare single and multiplayer offerings, as well as all DLC originally released as pre-order content.
